data.title: Real Cloudflare deploy — resources, secrets, custom domain

data.to:
BUILDPLAN: M-01 (deferred remainder) — carved out of MRQ-1 at operator ruling 2026-08-09 02:25 EDT: "put demo credentials in for the Cloudflare workers, I'll deal with that tomorrow."

MRQ-1 ships the skeleton validated locally against `wrangler dev` with placeholder resource IDs and an untracked `.dev.vars`. THIS ticket is the real thing, and it is BLOCKED ON THE OPERATOR until Cloudflare auth exists on the machine.

Scope:
- Operator prerequisites (not agent-doable): `wrangler login` as projects@stage11.ai (Stage11 Projects account); confirm the account is on Workers Paid.
- Create the real resources: D1 database, KV namespace, R2 bucket, Queue, cron trigger. Record their IDs.
- Replace every `REPLACE_ME-<binding>` placeholder in `wrangler.jsonc`; `account_id` supplied by env, never committed.
- Real secrets via `wrangler secret put` (Turnstile sitekey/secret replacing the published always-pass test keys; session signing key). Nothing secret enters the repo — it goes public.
- Deploy; wire the custom domain `marquee.stage11.dev` (HSTS-preloaded, https only); verify the health route and the session cookie over the real origin (cookie carries NO `Domain` attribute).
- Run the migration against the real D1 and seed it, so the deployed URL is the demo a judge can open.

Guardrail G6 and every "deployed URL" AC ultimately depend on this ticket, not on MRQ-1. Hours: 2 (plus operator time). Workflow: inline-full.
Plan: filled in by delegator's plan phase.

data.body: MRQ-14 real-Cloudflare checklist handoff: provision least-privilege S3 vars/secrets and media route; exact-origin CORS; first probe conditional presigned PUT/replay 412/custom-host failure/expiry; prove S3 PUT visible via R2 binding HEAD/ranges and mismatch delete; prove separate-origin attachment+nosniff and app-host 404; enable Image Resizing variants; run stale-orphan cron; configure real Turnstile and have MRQ-49 prove live presign pass plus invalid-token zero-side-effect rejection. Full checklist is in MRQ-14's authoritative plan.

## Real-bucket / deployed-only assertions inherited from MRQ-14 (uploads)

MRQ-14 verifies what it can against miniflare; these can ONLY be confirmed against real Cloudflare resources and are therefore this ticket's checklist, not a silent gap:

- Presigned PUT against the real S3 host: CORS, expiry, and replay → 412; and a PUT against a custom domain must FAIL (trap 9).
- S3 ↔ R2-binding coherence: HEAD and range reads agree; a checksum mismatch deletes the object.
- Separate-origin serving: `Content-Disposition: attachment` + `nosniff`; the same path on the app host 404s.
- Image Resizing variants for headshots.
- The orphan-sweep cron actually firing on the deployed Worker.
- Real Turnstile keys: a presign passes with a valid token and fails without one (replaces the always-pass test pair).

## M-01 seams MRQ-14 will add in its own PR (not operator work)

Exact S3 env/secret declarations in `wrangler.jsonc`, the scheduled/cron dispatch handler, the media host binding, and Worker-first media routing. Operator side here is only: the real secret VALUES via `wrangler secret put`, and the media host's DNS record.

data.body: DEPLOYED-MEASUREMENT CHECKLIST — added at MRQ-11 merge. **AC-16: program dashboard full render, p95 <= 1000ms over 10 warm loads against the seed.** MRQ-11 shipped the dashboard and correctly declined to claim a performance PASS, because `check:speed` is still MRQ-50 stub and the measurement is only meaningful against a deployed, seeded instance. Measure it here and record the number. AC-16 also carries a `felt` residual — "reads as an operator home, not a report" — settled by the operator at checkpoint C2, not by this ticket.

Verified live, not just merged: 'curl https://marquee.stage11.dev/health' returns {service: marquee, status: ok, build: 75b871d9, built_at: 2026-08-12T18:45:50Z} — the custom domain resolves, the Worker serves, and the deployed sha 75b871d9 is the current HEAD of github/main.
